title: HTML Intermediate Concepts - Module #9349
question: What is the primary benefit of using semantic HTML5 elements like `<article>` and `<section>`?
options: They speed up browser rendering by bypassing normal CSS layouts.
They automatically add border styling and padding on element `dropdown-menu`.
They encrypt form data before submitting it to the backend api.
They improve SEO indexing and screen-reader accessibility by describing page structure semantically.
answer: They improve SEO indexing and screen-reader accessibility by describing page structure semantically.
explanation: Semantic tags tell search engines and accessibility tools what kind of content is inside, enhancing access and ranking.
